description: Returns FDA animal and veterinary recall notices for a pet food or treat brand or product, newest first, with the reason, the company and the notice link. Also returns a curated list entry for common foods and plants (chocolate, grapes and raisins, xylitol, onions and garlic, macadamia nuts, alcohol, salt, lilies for cats, sago palm, azalea, oleander, tulips, daffodils and more): the source's wording, its page, the date it was read, and poison-control phone numbers (fees may apply). A name that is not on the list has no entry. Applies to questions about pet food recalls, or whether a food or plant is on the list of items toxic to dogs or cats. Results report what the official sources say and are not a safety assessment. Not veterinary advice. Human-food nutrition is outside this result.

query.description: A pet food or treat brand or product (e.g. 'Fromm', 'Pedigree wet dog food') or a food or plant name (e.g. 'grapes', 'lily', 'xylitol')
